reviews.author: Matt E., Facebook
reviews.text: I can't say enough good about you guys. Top notch service. Even got the pool furniture out of my pool after the recent hurricane. Very proactive and priced well for the quality of service.

reviews.author: Wendy G., Facebook
reviews.text: Two weeks ago our pool looked like a dangerous swamp. Cannot say enough about the awesome customer service and affordable pricing we have received from Pool-Aid to get it back up and running.

reviews.author: Blake H., Facebook
reviews.text: Our pool needed a LOT of work after the storms. Josh and his crew came almost every day and worked hard to get it back sparking. Great people, even better service. Can't recommend enough!!

about.title: A family pool company, around since 1996
text: Pool-Aid is family owned and operated, and we have been cleaning and repairing pools since 1996.
We treat you like family, because a pool is an investment and a place where memories are made. We keep notes and checklists specific to your pool, and we can adjust to your schedule.
Safety comes first for us, which is why we are CPO-certified, licensed and insured, and Josh DeRoche leads the company as president.
